summary: Comprehensive architectural and UX implementation plan for Scan Shield, an AI-powered senior digital safety companion for pensioners in India. Details the M3 pastel card-stack design system, Gemini multimodal scam scanner, 9-language localization engine, 3-tier persistent text sizing, Pause Before You Pay checklist, Emergency SOS center with 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in integration, voice assistant, learning center, volunteer community, and offline-first Room database architecture.
